stories.headline: Takaichi's LDP wins historic supermajority in snap election landslide
stories.summary: Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's Liberal Democratic Party secured 316 seats in Sunday's Lower House election, achieving a two-thirds supermajority and one of the biggest victories in postwar Japanese history. With coalition partner Japan Innovation Party, the ruling bloc won 352 of 465 seats.

stories.headline: Trump congratulates Takaichi and announces March summit invitation
stories.summary: US President Donald Trump congratulated PM Takaichi on her election victory and announced plans to host her at the White House on March 19. Trump had earlier endorsed Takaichi before the election, praising her 'Conservative, Peace Through Strength Agenda.'

stories.headline: Takaichi's viral popularity and 'Sana-mania' drives youth engagement
stories.summary: PM Takaichi's campaign generated unprecedented social media engagement, with her YouTube video surpassing 100 million views. The 'Sana-mania' phenomenon saw young voters embracing everything from her pink pen to handbags, creating a pop culture-like following around Japan's first female prime minister.

stories.headline: Japanese markets surge on Takaichi election victory
stories.summary: Japanese stocks jumped to record highs while government bonds sold off after Takaichi's landslide win. The Nikkei 225 hit an all-time high of 54,782.83, continuing the 'Takaichi trade' that began when she became LDP leader in October.

stories.headline: Emperor Naruhito hosts Nepal President in Tokyo diplomatic meeting
stories.summary: Emperor Naruhito and Empress Masako met with Nepalese President Ramchandra Paudel and his wife at the Imperial Palace. The meeting commemorated 70 years of diplomatic relations and included discussion of water advocacy and earthquake assistance.

stories.headline: Toyota names CFO Kenta Kon as new CEO amid profit decline
stories.summary: Toyota Motor announced CFO Kenta Kon will replace Koji Sato as CEO after the company reported a 43% drop in quarterly profit. Sato will become vice chairman and focus on industry leadership roles including at JAMA and Keidanren.

stories.headline: Keidanren business lobby invites activist fund Elliott for governance talks
stories.summary: Japan's most powerful business federation Keidanren invited US activist investor Elliott Investment Management to a closed-door meeting on March 5 to discuss corporate governance issues, highlighting growing shareholder activism in Japan.

stories.headline: Takaichi meets Nepal President, reaffirms democratic development support
stories.summary: Prime Minister Takaichi met with Nepalese President Ramchandra Paudel at her office, reaffirming Japan's support for Nepal's democratic development and regional stability. The meeting was part of celebrations marking 70 years of bilateral ties.
